name: What is the typical process for designing and installing custom cabinetry with a design-build firm?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and installing custom cabinetry with a design-build firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for designing and installing custom cabinetry within a comprehensive renovation project begins with an in-depth design consultation. Our team works with you to understand your aesthetic preferences, functional requirements, and overall vision. This leads to detailed design planning, often utilizing CAD-supported layouts to visualize the cabinetry within your space. Once designs are approved, materials are selected, and the cabinetry is custom-fabricated. Installation is then coordinated seamlessly with other renovation phases by our single, accountable design-build team, ensuring precise fit and finish without the complexities of managing multiple vendors. This integrated approach ensures clear communication and a smooth progression.
acceptedAnswer.description: Designing custom cabinetry involves initial consultation, detailed CAD-supported design planning, material selection, custom fabrication, and coordinated installation by our integrated design-build team.
